title: Worktree store bootstrap copies only the granted feature's cells
action: PBI p-9c48a67c: bee worktree new/register bootstraps the island store by copying .bee content wholesale, so stale uncapped cells belonging to OTHER features land in the fresh worktree's store — confusing workers and miscounting open work. Fix: locate the store-bootstrap copy in the worktree module (declared handlers.rs is a guess — follow the real site, name it). Rule: cells are copied only when their feature field equals the granted feature (any status); every other feature's cell files are skipped. Feature-neutral records the island needs (config, expertise, prompts, non-cell stores) keep copying exactly as today. Archived cells: skip other features' archives the same way. TDD red-first: fixture main store with cells of two features -> worktree new for feature A: island holds A's cells only, B absent; main store untouched; a feature with zero cells bootstraps an empty cells dir cleanly; existing worktree tests stay green.

truths: a fresh worktree store holds only the granted feature's cells
main store is untouched by the bootstrap filter
feature-neutral store content copies exactly as before

artifacts.substantive: filtered bootstrap plus tests (or the real site, named in the trace)

trace.outcome: bootstrap_worktree_store (registry.rs, real site) prunes foreign-feature cell files and archives already checked out, fills granted feature's cells; main store read-only; 4 new tests
